description: Check whether one contact, or a list of contacts, still works at the company your records hold. Returns one flat, Clay-ready JSON row per person: current employer, title, start month, role history, status (left, landed, promoted, or still there), how the person was matched, the source of the answer, and that source's date, with a namesake check. Runs on data you send (known_history) and on your own Serper or SerpApi, Prospeo, and BounceBan keys passed as inputs; this tool never fetches LinkedIn and holds no key of its own. Provide person_name with company_domain or company_name, or a people list. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Reads public data and writes nothing; requires an APIFY_TOKEN and consumes Apify credits per call.

bouncebanApiKey.description: Optional. Verifies the old work address only while the person still reads as at the company. Only an undeliverable answer is used. Your own key, sent as a run input; never stored by the actor.

cacheTtlDays.description: Reuse a reading made in the last N days, uncharged, from a store in your own Apify account. 0 turns it off. Rows with your own history are never cached. Default 7.

checkCompanySite.description: Free. Looks for the person on up to 4 team and about pages of the last known company domain.

checkNews.description: Free. Cites up to 3 headlines from the last year that name the person with a move word. Evidence only; a headline never sets the employer.

company_domain.description: Website domain of the company your records place this person at, for example microsoft.com. Left, landed, and promoted are worked out against this company.

company_linkedin_url.description: Optional. The strongest company match when a role history carries LinkedIn company URLs.

company_name.description: Name of that company. Used with or instead of the domain to match roles in the person's history.

email.description: Optional. The person's work address at the last known company. With a BounceBan key, an undeliverable answer marks the person as left.

includeRoleHistory.description: No keeps role_count and drops the role_history array.

input_id.description: Optional. Returned unchanged on the row so you can join it back to your CRM or table.

known_history.description: Optional. A role history you already have, as JSON: {"source": "heyreach", "source_date": "2026-10-07", "experiences": [...]} or {"source": "crm", "roles": [{"company_name", "title", "start_month", "end_month"}]}. Read before any paid key; a history newer than Max source age skips Prospeo.

last_known_title.description: The title your records hold. Echoed on the row as input_title.

maxPeople.description: Stop after this many people. Default 1000.

maxSourceAgeDays.description: A history you send that is older than this is treated as lagging, so the run also reads Prospeo and the search result. Default 30.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before any row that would take its event charges past this amount.

people.description: Many people at once. Each item takes the same keys as the single person fields: person_name, company_domain, company_name, last_known_title, profile_url, email, company_linkedin_url, location, input_id, and known_history (an object).

person_name.description: Full name of the person to check.

profile_url.description: Optional. The person's LinkedIn profile URL, used as the identity. This actor never opens it. Without it, the run looks the profile up with your search key and charges profile_resolved when it finds and accepts one.

prospeoApiKey.description: Optional. Prospeo enrich-person: the person's role history with start and end months. Skipped when you send a fresh history of your own. Your own key, sent as a run input; never stored by the actor.

serpApiKey.description: Optional. Used for web search only when no Serper key is set. Your own key, sent as a run input; never stored by the actor.

serperApiKey.description: Optional. Web search (serper.dev): finds profile URLs and reads the search result line for the current role. About 1 to 3 searches per person. Your own key, sent as a run input; never stored by the actor.

verifyOldEmail.description: With a BounceBan key: one check per person who still reads as at the company. Uses the address you send, or one Prospeo returns on the company domain.
